verdict.rationale: Mastercard Open Finance documents a broad public REST API covering account aggregation, transactions, balances, ACH details, owner verification and reports. Its documentation includes token-based auth with Partner ID, secret and appKey, plus a free unlimited Test Drive sandbox with test personas and FinBanks. A first-party OpenAPI specification repo supports generating a client library, which makes programmatic driving straightforward. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents or developers successfully drive the API end-to-end, since all evidence is vendor-authored.
